# gate_sweep.c allowlist -- documented (b)/(c) rejections.
#
# Format: one entry per line, "<target> <offset> <mask>" (mask is 0xff or
# 0x01, matching gate_sweep.c's own two flip masks). Blank lines and lines
# starting with '#' are ignored. Generated by running:
#   gate_sweep list
# and copying every "  <target>  offset=<N>  mask=<M>" line's fields
# verbatim; `gate_sweep check gate_sweep_allowlist.txt` fails (exit 1) and
# prints every entry not covered here.
#
# Every entry below is a byte offset where the *pristine* file opens under
# PS_FUZZ_CRC_FIXUP=always but a one-byte-flipped-then-refixed copy does
# not (see gate_sweep.c's own header comment for exactly what "does not"
# means: a literal "pagestore_core: open step ... failed" line). Each is
# classified per-target below as:
#   (b) a genuine semantic field: the flipped byte lands inside a value the
#       product's own semantic/ordering validation checks (an enum out of
#       range, a length/count bound, a cross-field consistency invariant,
#       an LSN/alignment/ordering rule, ...) -- rejecting it is correct
#       product behavior, not a fixup gap.
#   (c) a magic/version/shape-selecting identity field deliberately left
#       fuzzer-controlled (see fuzz/FIXUP_GATES.md's per-target rows) --
#       rejecting a mutation to it is exactly the point of leaving it
#       unpinned.
# No entry below is class (a) (a fixable gate); every fixable gate this
# sweep's first, buggy run (before its own stderr-capture bug -- see
# gate_sweep.c's run_one() comment -- was fixed) or PR #303's earlier
# manual rounds found has already been pinned in fuzz_crc_fixup.c.
#
# manifest (b/c): 0-3 magic, 8-11 type = (c) format-identity, left
# fuzzer-controlled like every other target's magic/type. 4-7 (version) is
# NOT in this list: it is inside the record header (offsets 0-19) but this
# fixup's own crc recompute already covers it and record 0's `len` is
# type-derived, so a version-only flip still opens (version is not
# independently checked by manifest_record_valid_at() the way magic/type
# select behavior). 20-27 (layer_id, first ADD_LAYER record): (b) --
# local_validate_layer_locations() (pagestore_layer_store.c:564) rebuilds
# the *expected* location URI from layer_id via local_layer_path() and
# requires it to match the record's own (real, unmutated) location URI --
# a genuine layer_id/URI consistency invariant, not a cross-file identity
# gate to pin past. 100-103 (location_count): (b) --
# manifest_layer_desc_valid() (pagestore_manifest.c:386) requires
# location_count <= PS_LAYER_MAX_LOCATIONS(3); a flipped byte overflows
# that bound essentially always.

# all three share fixup_forkmeta_records() over 64-byte ForkMetaRecV2

# payload header -- for the checkpoint/tail parts). Per record: magic (4
# bytes at the record's own offset 0) = (c) identity, deliberately
# unpinned (fork_meta_rec_wire_valid() checks it before anything else,
# same as every other target's magic). rec_len (the next 4 bytes) is NOT
# in this list: fixed this round (pinned to sizeof(ForkMetaRecV2)).
# Everything else in each record (timeline, PsKey, lsn, admission_seq,

# ordering checks on those fields (timeline range, key field validity,
# LSN/admission_seq ordering against what's already applied, kind enum).

#
# walidx_snapshot_shard (b/c): 0-7 = magic+version = (c) identity (bytes@8
# fixed this round; timeline/shard/generation/start_lsn/end_lsn/
# source_offset/crc all pinned or recomputed, none reject anymore). Per
# 64-byte WalIdxRec record starting at 72: magic+rec_len (the record's own
# offset 0-7) = (c) shape-selection (this fixup only ever seals the
# current 64-byte shape, so a wrong rec_len here is exactly analogous to
# walidx_log's own rec_len-selects-shape case); timeline (offset+16, i.e.
# absolute 88/152/216) is NOT in this list (pinned per round-4 fix,
# confirmed still holding); flags (offset+12) and lsn/end_lsn
# (offset+24/32) = (b): the same walidx_metadata_valid()-style semantic
# checks as every other WalIdxRec in this table.
#
